from pathlib import Path
import json,math,sys
import pandas as pd
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(sys.argv[1])/'cloud'))
from qresearch.evaluation import summarize_ic
def clean(value):
    if isinstance(value,float) and not math.isfinite(value):return None
    if isinstance(value,dict):return {k:clean(v) for k,v in value.items()}
    return value
cases={"positive_constant":[.7]*6,"negative_constant":[-.7]*6,"adjacent":[.7,math.nextafter(.7,math.inf)],"subnormal":[0.,math.ulp(0.)]}
print(json.dumps({k:{"input":v,"summary":clean(summarize_ic(pd.DataFrame({"ic":v,"n":[5]*len(v)})))} for k,v in cases.items()},allow_nan=False))
